question: How is the fulfilment time classified in general and special terms?
premises: The fulfilment time is defined in six ways through general and special forms.
The first and fifth days of the month are included in this classification.
These are designated as auspicious days.
inference: The text begins a sixfold classification of fulfilment times, starting with the first and fifth days of the month.
uncertainties: The full sixfold scheme is only begun here and continues in later verses.
plain_english: The fulfilment time is defined in six ways, by general and special forms. Among these, the first and fifth days of the month are called auspicious days.
